methodology.purpose: Supply prior-season caller identities for a time-correct 2023 forecast backtest.
methodology.source_scope: Only the factual Current Coaching Staffs table and its Offensive Playcaller column are used. No player, team, win, or fantasy projection from the surrounding guide is an input.
methodology.time_rule: The source PDF embeds a September 8, 2022 creation timestamp and was available long before the August 23, 2023 target caller census. It is prior-history evidence, not a same-season 2022 forecast source.
methodology.identity_rule: Transcribe the Offensive Playcaller column exactly enough to preserve identity; do not infer a caller from the offensive-coordinator title.
